deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy of tag v2.7.3 to production-canary (region us-west-2) — commit 9d4f2b7
ashley: saw the deploybot msg, queuing a look.
mike: getting the CI gate report now.
deploy-bot: CI gate failed: 2 checks failed, 3 pending. Failing checks: model-compatibility-check, kv-cache-smoke. See logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/9d4f2b7
carmen: ugh model-compatibility again. test failed after quantize step.
jamie: can you paste the failing log lines?
mike: logs snippet:
```
ERROR: model-compatibility-check
Mismatch in attention-kernel signatures for layer 12
Expected KV cache layout "v2" but got "v2-quant"
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/compat/test_model.py", line 88, in test_kv_layout
    assert layout == expected
AssertionError: 'v2-quant' != 'v2'
```
ashley: that matches the AOT quantization change we merged yesterday. Deploy should be pinned until we either revert quantization or provide a compatible runtime.
carmen: can we fallback to the previous runtime variant? I think prod has a v2-compatible runtime image.
jamie: deploy-bot, can you show available model/runtime variants for this tag?
deploy-bot: Available runtime variants for 9d4f2b7: [runtime-v2, runtime-v2-quant, runtime-v2-compat] — runtime-v2-compat is only staged in us-east-1 currently.
mike: ops note: runtime-v2-compat isn't in us-west-2, so canary would still hit v2-quant and fail.
ashley: options: 1) rollback the commit (revert quantization change) 2) promote runtime-v2-compat to us-west-2 (takes ~20m) 3) pin canary to an older tag without quant changes.
carmen: I'm leaning to promote runtime-v2-compat to us-west-2, but we need a quick patch to config to ensure healthchecks pass.
jamie: if promotion takes 20m we should hold the deploy. Anyone object to pausing the canary? :pause_button:
mike: hold it. I'll open the runtime rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy paused by ashley — reason: CI gate failed (model compatibility).
oncall-bot: Paging oncall: @mike (1/3) — deploy paused requires ops approval for cross-region runtime promotion.
mike: approved, starting promotion. ETA ~18m.
ashley: I also flagged a regression test to run once promoted: tests/compat/test_model::test_kv_layout with quantization matrix.
carmen: can someone post the rollback command in case the rollout fails?
jamie: rollback command: `./scripts/deploy rollback --env production-canary --tag 9d4f2b7` (dry-run first).
mike: runtime promotion started — rolling out runtime-v2-compat to us-west-2 nodes (batch 1/4).
deploy-bot: Noted. CI gate status: failing -> pending (waiting on runtime rollout).
ashley: thanks team, keep updates short. if rollout fails, we'll revert the quantization commit and reopen a PR with compatibility tests.
carmen: copy. monitoring dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/runtime-rollout/9d4f2b7
mike: batch 1/4 successful, batch 2/4 in progress.
jamie: pls run the quick smoke: `pytest tests/compat/test_model.py::test_kv_layout -q` after batch 2.
mike: smoke passed on batch 2, batch 3/4 in progress.
deploy-bot: CI gate re-evaluating checks...
mike: batch 3 complete, batch 4 in progress.
ashley: any sign of flakiness?
mike: no flakiness observed so far.
ashley: ok, hold lift once rollout finished and compatibility test passes.
carmen: ETA ~6m to finish batch 4.
deploy-bot: Runtime rollout completed. Re-running model-compatibility-check.
deploy-bot: CI gate passed — all checks green. Canary deploy resuming.
ashley: resuming canary. monitor token-level latency on canary route please.
jamie: will watch latency and error rate.
mike: canary promoted to 10% traffic. No errors after 12m.
ashley: green across metrics, proceed to gradual rollout per usual schedule. :rocket:
jamie: note: opened follow-up ticket to add a compatibility matrix to pre-merge checks to avoid future surprises — TICKET-2419.
carmen: adding a quick note in release notes: "v2.7.3: quantization toggle introduced; rollout gated by runtime compatibility."
ashley: nice. closing thread.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy of v2.7.3 finished (status: resumed -> canary 10%).
